atoms.text:
Act I, Scene II

(Setting: a mountainous forest with a cave. It’s a sunny day in spring, the flowers are blooming, the birds are chirping.)

Ted the Tender: (stomach growling) I’m so hungry I could eat a horse!

Rubellious the Ridiculous: (huffing) Ted, don’t be ridiculous. We took an oath to stay away from meat a million years ago. The cave is full of carrots and avocados to fill your big old tender stomach.

Ted the Tender: You’re calling me ridiculous? (pointing to himself, puffing his chest) I am Ted the Tender! (pointing his tail at Rubellious) You’re the ridiculous one! Your name is Rubellious the Ridiculous. (huffs)

Rubellious the Ridiculous: (rolls his eyes) Whatever, Ted. (pauses) Hey, did you hear that noise?

(A shuffling noise can be heard. In the distance, something falls and clatters on the ground, echoing loudly in the cave.)
